purpose: Say that responsibility or circumstances prevent an otherwise possible action.
keywords: Verb dictionary form + わけにはいかない; negative form + わけにはいかない
I have an exam tomorrow, so I cannot go out and have fun.
It is confidential, so I cannot tell you.
I was invited, so I cannot simply not go.
formation: Verb dictionary form + わけにはいかない; negative form + わけにはいかない
restrictions: Negative verb + わけにはいかない means one cannot avoid doing it.
mistake: This is a social or situational constraint, not simple physical inability.
